Interface Configurer<T, R extends Registry>

All Known Implementing Classes:
CustomMappingsConfigurer, CustomModelClassFactoryConfigurer, CustomRouteBuilderConfigurer, DynamicExtensionConfigurer, OrderedConfigurer
@Deprecated(since="6.0.0", forRemoval=true) public interface Configurer<T, R extends Registry>
Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
the whole Configurer SPI only ever expressed "collect all beans of type T and push them into some holder", which core Spring expresses as beanFactory.getBeanProvider(T.class).orderedStream(). Holders now collect their own contributions while the singletons are being initialized instead of being filled from the outside once an application context has been refreshed. See org.openehealth.ipf.commons.spring.map.SpringBidiMappingService, org.openehealth.ipf.commons.spring.core.extend.SpringDynamicExtensionRegistrar, org.openehealth.ipf.modules.hl7.config.CustomModelClassesRegistrar and org.openehealth.ipf.platform.camel.core.config.CustomRouteBuilderConfigurer.
Base interface to implement for any custom configurers.

Boris Stanojevic
